name: TransferPayType

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 同步或订阅任务ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method after conversion. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.
<props="china">
sync_serverless: pay-as-you-go Serverless.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的付费方式，取值：
PrePaid：预付费，即包年包月。
PostPaid：后付费，即按量付费。
<props="china">
sync_serverless：后付费Serverless。</props>
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the subscription instance. Valid values:
Year: annual subscription.
Month: monthly subscription.

This parameter is valid and required only when ChargeType is set to PrePaid (subscription)
parameters.help_zh:
预付费实例的计费方式，取值：
Year：包年。
Month：包月。

当ChargeType为PrePaid（预付费）时，该参数才有效且必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance.
If Period is set to Year, valid values are 1 to 5.
If Period is set to Month, valid values are 1 to 60.

This parameter is valid and required only when ChargeType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
预付费实例购买时长。
当Period为Year（包年）时，取值范围为1~5。
当Period为Month（包月）时，取值范围为1~60。

当ChargeType为Prepaid（预付费）时，该参数才有效且必须传入
parameters.name: buy_count

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of DTS Units (DUs) for the Serverless instance. Valid values: 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16.

<props="intl">
This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.</props>
<props="china">
This parameter is valid and required only when ChargeType is set to sync_serverless.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless实例的DU下限，取值为：1、2、4、8、16。

<props="intl">
当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入参数。</props>
<props="china">
当ChargeType为sync_serverless时，该参数才有效且必须传入。</props>
parameters.name: min_du

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of DUs for the Serverless instance. Valid values: 2, 4, 8, and 16.
<props="intl">
This feature is currently not supported. Do not specify this parameter.</props>
<props="china">
This parameter is valid and required only when ChargeType is set to sync_serverless.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless实例的DU上限，取值为：2、4、8、16。
<props="intl">
当前暂不支持此功能，请勿传入参数。</props>
<props="china">

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method after conversion. Valid values:

修改后的付费方式，返回值：
PrePaid：预付费。
PostPaid：后付费

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter will be deprecated
Code.description_zh: 错误码，本参数即将下线

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message used to replace the %s variable in the ErrMessage parameter.
For example, if ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

EndTime.description_en:
The time when the subscription instance expires, in UNIX timestamp format.
If the instance is converted to pay-as-you-go, this value is empty.
You can use a search engine to find a UNIX timestamp conversion tool
EndTime.description_zh:
预付费实例到期时间，格式为Unix时间戳。
如修改后的实例为后付费实例，则该值为空值。
Unix时间戳转换工具可用搜索引擎获取

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
